entries.title: Tell HN: Thank you whoishiring, a.k.a. Matthew Walsh-Cloonagh
entries.author: dang
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Thank you whoishiring, a.k.a. Matthew Walsh-Cloonagh
entries.excerpt: Back in 2011, an HN user volunteered to consolidate the scattered "who is hiring" posts that were popping up and post one automatically at the start of each month. This not only worked well, it became an HN institution. https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=2391828 Four years of yeoman service later, our mysterious benefactor has gotten a lot busier and arranged with us to take over the account. I asked if we could thank him publicly and he said sure. So thank you, Matthew Wal
entries.guide_zh: 感谢主动建立每月招聘帖机制的 Matthew Walsh-Cloonagh，回看社区长期受益。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (May 2015)

entries.title: Ask HN: Where can I buy real software companies?
entries.author: bluedevil2k
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Where can I buy real software companies?
entries.excerpt: So I have a software company that is generating a good amount of cash. I'd like to buy another small software company and (ideally) optimize it and make some more money. Problem - most of the sites, like flippa, have crap businesses for sale. Is there a real place that one can find $50k - $500k software businesses for sale? Side projects that people make money from but don't have the time for?
entries.guide_zh: 已有现金流的软件公司经营者，想收购另一家小公司，该去哪里找？

entries.title: Ask HN: How do I put together a computer for my blind mom?
entries.author: probably_wrong
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do I put together a computer for my blind mom?
entries.excerpt: As the title says, I want to design an interface that my blind mom can use. I tried JAWS, but as an old woman she finds it too complex. I fear the same will happen with a non-custom emacspeak. I just need to patch together something that reads web pages in Spanish, books, and maybe e-mail. That's it. Has any of you done something similar?
entries.guide_zh: 常见读屏软件太复杂，作者想为失明母亲搭建容易使用的电脑界面。

entries.title: Ask HN: I Have Cancer. What Should I Do?
entries.author: dammit_lump
entries.current_title: Ask HN: I Have Cancer. What Should I Do?
entries.excerpt: I just left my engineering job at a medium-large employer to join an 18-person startup. I am set to start the new gig late next week. I found a marble-sized lump under my armpit a few days ago. I quickly got it checked out, and the preliminary report just came back that it's probably cancerous. What the hell should I do? I'm 25, and otherwise healthy, so was not expecting this. I really care about this new team and was excited to work with them. I feel horrible about joining
entries.guide_zh: 刚辞去旧工作准备加入小公司，却发现自己患癌，作者求助如何安排。

entries.title: Go Lang: Comments Are Not Directives
entries.author: Merkur
entries.current_title: Go Lang: Comments Are Not Directives
entries.excerpt: Go 1.4 starts to use comments as directives. I think that is a realy bad path to go on the long run. You see its beginnings in following 3 examples: # used to set a canonical import path for a package: //import "foo" # used to generate code: //go:generate bar # used to document the result of a example function: //Output: foo Comments should not be directives. Comments are free form, they do not have a syntax (as demonstrated in the examples). Comments are for humans - program
entries.guide_zh: Go 开始借注释表达指令，作者担忧这会给语言长期设计带来问题。
